import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int[] D4X = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static final int[] D4Y = {-1, 1, 0, 0};
    static final long INF = 1_000_000_000_000_000_000L;

    static class Edge {
        int src, dst;
        long capacity, current_flow;

        Edge(int s, int d, long c) {
            src = s;
            dst = d;
            capacity = c;
            current_flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static class MaxFlowAlgorithm {
        List<Edge> edgelist;
        List<List<Integer>> adj;
        int V, source, sink;
        int[] depth, it;
        Queue<Integer> q;

        MaxFlowAlgorithm(int nodes, int s, int t) {
            V = nodes;
            source = s;
            sink = t;
            adj = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < V; i++) {
                adj.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            depth = new int[V];
            it = new int[V];
            q = new LinkedList<>();
        }

        void insert(int u, int v, long cap) {
            edgelist.add(new Edge(u, v, cap));
            edgelist.add(new Edge(v, u, 0));
            adj.get(u).add(edgelist.size() - 2);
            adj.get(v).add(edgelist.size() - 1);
        }

        boolean buildLevels() {
            Arrays.fill(depth, -1);
            depth[source] = 0;
            q.offer(source);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (int idx : adj.get(u)) {
                    Edge e = edgelist.get(idx);
                    if (e.capacity - e.current_flow > 0 && depth[e.dst] == -1) {
                        depth[e.dst] = depth[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(e.dst);
                    }
                }
            }
            return depth[sink] != -1;
        }

        long augment(int u, long bottleneck) {
            if (u == sink) return bottleneck;
            for (int i = it[u]; i < adj.get(u).size(); i++) {
                it[u] = i;
                int idx = adj.get(u).get(i);
                Edge e = edgelist.get(idx);
                if (depth[e.dst] == depth[u] + 1 && e.capacity - e.current_flow > 0) {
                    long flow = augment(e.dst, Math.min(bottleneck, e.capacity - e.current_flow));
                    if (flow > 0) {
                        e.current_flow += flow;
                        edgelist.get(idx ^ 1).current_flow -= flow;
                        return flow;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long maxFlow() {
            long total = 0;
            while (buildLevels()) {
                Arrays.fill(it, 0);
                while (true) {
                    long flow = augment(source, INF);
                    if (flow <= 0) break;
                    total += flow;
                }
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    static int gridSize, timeLimit;
    static String[] resourceGrid;
    static String[] capacityGrid;
    static int[][] bfsDist;
    static int[][][][][] dpCache;
    static boolean[][][][][] computed;

    static boolean inside(int r, int c) {
        return r >= 0 && r < gridSize && c >= 0 && c < gridSize && 
               resourceGrid[r].charAt(c) != 'Y' && resourceGrid[r].charAt(c) != 'Z';
    }

    static void multiSourceBfs(int sr, int sc) {
        bfsDist = new int[gridSize][gridSize];
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(bfsDist[i], -1);
        }
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(new int[]{sr, sc});
        bfsDist[sr][sc] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = x + D4X[k], ny = y + D4Y[k];
                if (inside(nx, ny) && bfsDist[nx][ny] == -1) {
                    bfsDist[nx][ny] = bfsDist[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; j++) {
                if (bfsDist[i][j] == -1) bfsDist[i][j] = 1_000_000_000;
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean connectivityCheck(int timeStep, int r1, int c1, int r2, int c2) {
        if (bfsDist[r1][c1] < timeStep) return false;
        if (r1 == r2 && c1 == c2) return true;
        if (timeStep >= timeLimit) return false;
        if (bfsDist[r1][c1] <= timeStep) return false;
        if (computed[timeStep][r1][c1][r2][c2]) return dpCache[timeStep][r1][c1][r2][c2] == 1;
        
        computed[timeStep][r1][c1][r2][c2] = true;
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
            int nr = r1 + D4X[k], nc = c1 + D4Y[k];
            if (nr < 0 || nr >= gridSize || nc < 0 || nc >= gridSize) continue;
            if (resourceGrid[nr].charAt(nc) == 'Y' || resourceGrid[nr].charAt(nc) == 'Z') continue;
            if (connectivityCheck(timeStep + 1, nr, nc, r2, c2)) {
                dpCache[timeStep][r1][c1][r2][c2] = 1;
                return true;
            }
        }
        dpCache[timeStep][r1][c1][r2][c2] = 0;
        return false;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        gridSize = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        timeLimit = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        
        resourceGrid = new String[gridSize];
        capacityGrid = new String[gridSize];
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
            resourceGrid[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
            capacityGrid[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        
        bfsDist = new int[gridSize][gridSize];
        boolean foundZ = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; j++) {
                if (resourceGrid[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    multiSourceBfs(i, j);
                    foundZ = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (foundZ) break;
        }
        
        if (!foundZ) {
            // If no Z found, initialize bfsDist with large values
            for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
                Arrays.fill(bfsDist[i], 1_000_000_000);
            }
        }
        
        List<int[]> resList = new ArrayList<>();
        List<int[]> capList = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; j++) {
                char c = resourceGrid[i].charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Z' && c != 'Y' && c != '0') {
                    resList.add(new int[]{i, j});
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; j++) {
                char c = capacityGrid[i].charAt(j);
                if (c != 'Z' && c != 'Y' && c != '0') {
                    capList.add(new int[]{i, j});
                }
            }
        }
        
        int numNodes = resList.size() + capList.size() + 2;
        MaxFlowAlgorithm mfa = new MaxFlowAlgorithm(numNodes, 0, numNodes - 1);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < resList.size(); i++) {
            long capacity = resourceGrid[resList.get(i)[0]].charAt(resList.get(i)[1]) - '0';
            mfa.insert(0, i + 1, capacity);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < capList.size(); i++) {
            long capacity = capacityGrid[capList.get(i)[0]].charAt(capList.get(i)[1]) - '0';
            mfa.insert(resList.size() + 1 + i, numNodes - 1, capacity);
        }
        
        // Initialize dpCache and computed arrays
        dpCache = new int[65][12][12][12][12];
        computed = new boolean[65][12][12][12][12];
        
        for (int i = 0; i < resList.size(); i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < capList.size(); j++) {
                if (connectivityCheck(0, resList.get(i)[0], resList.get(i)[1], capList.get(j)[0], capList.get(j)[1])) {
                    mfa.insert(i + 1, resList.size() + 1 + j, 10000000L);
                }
            }
        }
        
        System.out.println(mfa.maxFlow());
    }
}
